findings.source_quote: “Watch them be healed, shoulder their burden of grief, and then move on toward their heavenly home.”
findings.suggested_fix: Change the clause to make clear that the person being addressed is to help carry the grieving friend’s burden, for example: “Kyk hoe hulle genees word, help om hulle las van droefheid te dra, en stap dan saam met hulle verder op pad na hulle hemelse tuiste.”
findings.translation_quote: “Kyk hoe hulle genees word, hulle las van droefheid op hulle skouers neem en dan verder stap op pad na hulle hemelse tuiste.”
